messages.subject: inla.stack
parts:
Hi, I am trying to fit the SPDE model with inla.stack(), this is what I used to do without using it

spde= inla.spde2.matern(mesh)
formula = response ~X + Y + X + f(spatial, model=spde) 
r  = inla(formula, data = theD@data)

and I am trying 

A3 <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc=as.matrix(theD@data[,c("x","y")]))
st3.dat <- inla.stack(data=list(resp=theD$response), A=list(A3),
        effects=list(X = theD$X, Y = theD$Y, Z = theD$Z, tag='est')

I got 

Error in inla.stack.default(data = list(resp = theD$response), A = list(A3),  : 
  length(A)=1 should be equal to length(effects)=3

Can anyone help on what did I do wrong?

Thanks

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.stack
parts:
On 16/04/13 16:01, Lennon wrote:
> Hi, I am trying to fit the SPDE model with inla.stack(), this is what
> I used to do without using it
>
> spde= inla.spde2.matern(mesh)
> formula = response ~X + Y + X + f(spatial, model=spde)
> r = inla(formula, data = theD@data)
>
> and I am trying
>
> A3 <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc=as.matrix(theD@data[,c("x","y")]))
> st3.dat <- inla.stack(data=list(resp=theD$response), A=list(A3),
> effects=list(X = theD$X, Y = theD$Y, Z = theD$Z, tag='est')

The last line needs to be
effects=list(list(X = theD$X, Y = theD$Y, Z = theD$Z)), tag='est')

Also, you likely will need to treat the Intercept as an explicit
covariate, like
formula = response ~-1+Intercept+X + Y + X + f(spatial, model=spde)
...
effects=list(list(Intercept=1,X = theD$X, Y = theD$Y, Z =
theD$Z)), tag='est')

See the SPDE tutorials on http://www.r-inla.org/examples/tutorials

Finn
